protocol.name: Table I canonical LPIPS-only evaluation
protocol.aggregation: frame-wise mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1)
protocol.prediction_resize: bilinear to target size only when necessary
protocol.mask_resize: nearest-neighbour to target size when necessary
protocol.full_mask: inverse binary tool mask; absent tool mask means all tissue
protocol.hole_mask: non-tool tissue intersected with canonical raw-DSS hole mask
protocol.lpips: scalar AlexNet LPIPS on tissue-zeroed pairs; [0,1] inputs normalized internally to [-1,1]
protocol.hole_lpips: spatial AlexNet LPIPS map averaged over the canonical H mask; [0,1] inputs normalized internally to [-1,1]
